description:
Smart Classrooms Launched in Palghar! A New Era of Digital Learning Begins ✨*
We are proud to announce the successful inauguration of the *‘Smart Classroom’ Project* at *M. N. Dandekar High School, Palghar* - run by Aryan Education Society.
This impactful project has been jointly executed by *Rotary Club of Bombay Bayview* and *Rotary Club of Palghar*.
Under this initiative, *5 state-of-the-art Interactive Smart Boards* have been donated to the school, transforming five traditional classrooms into vibrant digital learning hubs.
The inauguration was held in an enthusiastic atmosphere in the presence of Chief Guests *Rtn. Sonali Shah (Past President, RC Bombay Bayview) & Rtn. Vidya Murjani (Director, RC Bombay Bayview).*
*Why it Matters:*
Digital learning will make teaching more audio-visual, interactive, and student-centric. Subjects like Science, Maths & Geography will now be taught with videos, animations and digital tools - making learning easier, more engaging and more effective.
